class.name: Toast
class.description:
Toast describes a short message that appears near the bottom of the screen and fades out automatically. Create one with [method make_text], optionally attach a custom scene via [member custom_scene], then display it with [method Context.show_toast] or [method Activity.show_toast].
If [member custom_scene] is set, [ActivityManager] instantiates that scene instead of the default panel+label. The custom scene root may implement [code]_on_start(toast: Toast)[/code] to receive the Toast data after [code]_ready()[/code].
Each Toast has an optional [code]owner[/code] (set by ActivityManager). When the owner is destroyed, the Toast is removed from the pending queue.

method.name: get_custom_scene
method.description: Returns the custom scene path ([code].tscn[/code]) used for rendering this Toast, or an empty string for the default look.

method.name: get_duration
method.description: Returns how long the Toast stays on screen (in seconds), excluding fade-in and fade-out.

method.name: get_owner
method.description: Returns the lifecycle owner of this Toast, or [code]null[/code] if unassigned or the owner has been destroyed.

method.name: get_text
method.description: Returns the message text of this Toast.

method.name: make_text
method.description: Creates a new Toast with plain text. Equivalent to [code]Context.make_toast(text, duration)[/code]. [codeblock] var t = Toast.make_text("Hello World", 3.0) show_toast(t) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_custom_scene
method.description: Sets a custom [code].tscn[/code] path for rendering this Toast. If empty, the default panel+label is used. [codeblock] var t = Toast.make_text("Custom look", 3.0) t.set_custom_scene("res://scenes/toast_custom.tscn") show_toast(t) [/codeblock]

method.name: set_duration
method.description: Sets how long the Toast stays on screen (in seconds).

method.name: set_owner
method.description: Sets the lifecycle owner. Set by [ActivityManager]; manual use is not normally needed.

method.name: set_text
method.description: Sets the message text of this Toast.

members.member: Optional [code].tscn[/code] path for a custom Toast layout. When non-empty, [ActivityManager] instantiates this scene instead of the default panel+label.
